entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: St. Andrew's Church is a Catholic church in Antwerp built in the 16th century. Its exterior is mainly characterised by a late-Gothic style while its interior is predominantly executed in Baroque style. It is the parish church of the Parish of St. Andrew's. In the 19th century, St. Andrew's Parish was known as the parish of misery as it was by then mainly populated by poor people.
